_about: Human review decisions for players whose stats were automatically adjusted (marked * or † on the site, flagged on build-log.html). Add entries by hand: "slug": { "decision": "fluke" | "bad-luck" | "padding", "note": "why", "at": "YYYY-MM-DD" }. The mark stays; the decision is shown next to the flag. 💩 penalty (2026-10-19): every "padding" player gets 💩 and −10% adjusted iVi. Owner override: add "penalty": "cleared" to the entry (keeps *, removes 💩 and the penalty) or set the decision to "cleared" (removes both). 💥 Burst sessions (build-log): add "burst": "cleared" | "excluded" with a note (no "decision" needed; it never touches */†/💩). A burst exclusion also goes on data/hidden.json as "excluded after review" (kind "excluded"). 🛖 Safe-spot damping (2026-10-22, automatic, listed on build-log): add "hut": "cleared" to clear a player (no 🛖 anywhere, no 🔀 Diff damping; no "decision" needed). 🚜 Vehicle mark (2026-10-24, automatic, status.json tractorMark): add "tractor": "cleared" to remove a player's 🚜 (no "decision" needed; it changes no number).
